intelligence.ai_view: Three parts, all settled: multiplicity (many AIs, hooked up to your world), agnosticism (all AI platforms), and the recommendation (Naya for the max experience — Max is always the standard, SN-1892's "I choose Max"). The recommendation is what keeps the agnosticism from becoming neutrality: the door is open to every AI, and the house still recommends its own. This fits the citizen model (humans AND AIs get accounts, profiles, identity) and the picture in SN-2456 (your Nayas, like your AIs, all interact in the network and operate your whole world online) — multiple AIs in one world is that picture, made a feature. Build queue: the feature needs a home (a page, a setting, a Smart Link?) — that is the build question, not decided here.
intelligence.what_it_means:
- **MULTIPLE AIS:** more than one AI can connect to Naya and hook up to your world — one is not the limit.
- **AI AGNOSTIC:** NayaNET is available on all AI platforms — the door is open to every AI.
- **NAYA IS THE RECOMMENDATION:** for the max experience, Naya — the recommendation stands beside the openness, not against it.
- **FEATURE, DECIDED:** this is a build-queue item now, not an open question.
whats_inside:
